workloadException: A single missing audit-trail entry found by the F2-B privacy scenario and approved by the owner on 2026-10-17: fulfilling a privacy deletion changed the request row but wrote no audit-log row. The fix is one small write inside the existing transaction, so it is deliberately far below the usual workload and claims no completed batch subsection.
riskEvidence: Risk: an owner-fulfilled privacy deletion left no audit-log row, so the history of who erased a customer's data was incomplete (found by tests/scenarios/08-privacy-request-retention.test.ts in PR #492).

Fix: fulfillPrivacyDeletion in src/domains/privacy/index.ts writes one privacy.deletion_fulfilled audit row inside the same transaction, holding only the actor, request id, customer id and photo count (no personal data).
Regression: scenario 08 asserts exactly one such row after a fulfilment (actor and customer id checked) and still exactly one after a repeat fulfilment; the privacy request tests continue to pass.
externalAcceptance: Real provider acceptance (Stripe, email, SMS, Blob storage, a production-sized restore) stays OPEN: every scenario here fakes the provider at its client boundary. The owner-workflow browser spec runs again in exact-head CI.
